title: Privacy Policy
subtitle: Rules for processing your personal data

sections.title: 1. General Information
content: This policy applies to the website softwave-labs.com.
The data controller is A. Tabaczka, Beyond Office, Fabryka Norblina, Żelazna 51/53 building C, 00-841 Warsaw, Poland.
Contact with the data controller: softwavelabs@protonmail.com
The service processes data for the purposes of handling contact forms, fulfilling ordered services, and conducting direct marketing.

sections.title: 2. Data Protection
content: The connection to the website is encrypted using an SSL certificate.
User passwords are stored in hashed form — it is not possible to reverse them.
The operator regularly updates the software used to process data.

sections.title: 3. Hosting and Infrastructure
content: The service is hosted by external cloud service providers.
Providers may process technical data such as IP address, server logs, URLs, request time, and browser information.
We currently use Vercel and Render services.

sections.title: 4. Your Rights
content: You have the right to access your data, rectify it, delete it, restrict processing, and transfer it.
You may object to data processing for marketing purposes.
You have the right to lodge a complaint with the President of the Personal Data Protection Office, ul. Stawki 2, 00-193 Warsaw, Poland.
Data is not transferred outside the European Union.

sections.title: 5. Forms
content: The service collects data voluntarily provided by the user in contact forms.
The data is processed solely for handling the request or establishing business contact.
The service may store connection parameters such as time and IP address.

sections.title: 6. Marketing Techniques
content: The service uses Google Analytics for anonymous traffic analysis.
Remarketing techniques are used to tailor ads to user behavior — without transferring personal data.
The service uses the Facebook pixel, which informs Facebook about visits to the website.
Heatmaps and user behavior recordings are used — data is anonymized before being transmitted.

sections.title: 7. Cookies
content: The service uses cookies — text files stored on the user's device.
Cookies are used to maintain user sessions and for marketing purposes.
Two types of cookies are used: session cookies (temporary) and persistent cookies (stored for a specified time).
Users can manage cookies through browser settings: Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, Opera.
